How Klipnux works.

Three fluid steps from long raw footage to vertical reels you can publish right away.

01 · INSTANT UNLOCK

Hours of footage in one tap

Drop movies, 3-hour podcasts, or camera-roll clips and land directly inside the editor with peak scenes and chapters laid out.

02 · TACTILE TIMELINE

Drag handles & split on mobile

Thumb-sized golden trim brackets, continuous frame thumbnails, live audio waveform scrubbing, and one-tap Split at the playhead.

03 · SYNCED CAPTIONS

Style captions & export 1080p

Switch 8 viral subtitle presets live, type or dictate custom script words, frame speakers Left or Right, and export MP4 or ZIP.
